rich_text.text: The main requirements I relied on, from public sources
Live in Georgia for at least 6 months

cells.text: f) a document issued by the Legal Entity of Public Law – Revenue Service proving that the annual turnover of the employing enterprise/an enterprise founded by an alien (except for an educational or medical institution) per alien applying for a work residence permit is not less than GEL 50 000, and in case of educational or medical institutions the annual turnover is not less than GEL 35 000 per alien applying for a work residence permit;
In short: your business's annual turnover must be at least GEL 50,000 per foreign applicant (GEL 35,000 for educational or medical institutions).

rich_text.text: Earn and declare at least GEL 50,000 over the last 12 months

I read this recommendation in a public source and had it confirmed by a friend who got his residence permit as an individual entrepreneur in spring 2024 (when he applied, more than 9 months remained on his legal stay in Georgia).
Do a visa run so that more than 9 months remain on your legal stay in Georgia (6 months minimum, ideally more than 9)
